title: Assessment engine, DLP analysis footprint and efficacy analyzer

checks.what: Every check of the engine with every read refused (403) is not permitted; with 401 never PASS
Manual checks that read nothing (MC.6-MC.11, 11.x, 12.7, 12.10, 12.14, B.13, E.10, E.14) stay REVIEW: docs/SCORING.md defines REVIEW as 'a person has to judge it'; none is a PASS
Score arithmetic oracle, INFO/ERROR excluded, None when nothing scoreable, out-of-scope and malformed rows never passes, maturity boundaries, compute() agrees with permissions.assessment_summary
Alternative-channel checks hidden not run; ZCC/ZPA/ZDX/ZIdentity reads refused unless selected; efficacy never reads Web DLP rules out of scope
Nulls, numbers for strings, scalars for lists, non-objects, 50 000 devices, seeded fuzz (12 000 random tenants offline; 120 in the suite)
CLI (Rich and plain), required-controls Markdown, efficacy CSV (formula), Markdown (HTML/table), DOCX (XML-illegal chars)
Client read/write/sign-in errors and efficacy read errors carry no secret
Report 0600, report name cannot traverse, config size/nesting/encoding caps
Tenant regex runs in a bounded subprocess (CPU/AS rlimits, timeout); broad patterns are not simulated
Engine expression format ((D63.S > 1)) verified in zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3 zia/dlp_engine.py; ZCC numeric device states per zscaler.utils.zcc_param_map
Spliced zcc_evaluation checks pass on zero profiles (outside these files)

findings.title: Refused (401/403) reads reported as PASS by 11 checks and as REVIEW by about 40 more
findings.fix: Every read goes through _g, so a refused read is an INFO naming HTTP 403: not permitted, outside the score

findings.title: Checks that read nothing, or found nothing to judge, counted as passes (10.4, MC.12, 8.5 with no enabled rule, 6.1 with no device)
findings.fix: 10.4 reads devices, MC.12 is informational, 8.5 with zero rules is REVIEW, 6.1 with no device is INFO

findings.title: 50+ checks raised on null, numeric or non-object tenant records (state None, numeric names, bool urlCategories, int fileTypes)
findings.fix: _g keeps objects only; _s/_on/_lst read text and list fields defensively

findings.title: Efficacy engine-expression parser ignored the SDK format ((D63.S > 1)), so every custom dictionary was flagged unused by engines
findings.fix: Parse \bD\(?\s*(\d+) (SDK and legacy forms), distinct ids in order

findings.title: Efficacy hid refused reads: a 403 on rules flagged every engine unused, a 403 on dictionaries looked like an empty tenant
findings.fix: read_errors lists each failed read; a refused rule read is unknown (None), never unused

findings.title: Rich markup and terminal escape injection from tenant text in the CLI report (OSC 8 hyperlink, styling, ESC sequences)
findings.fix: _term strips control characters and escapes Rich markup for every tenant string printed

findings.title: Client read and write errors were not passed through the secret mask (exception text echoing the client secret)
Saved JSON report written with the process umask (world-readable) though it describes the tenant's security posture
findings.fix: Written with os.open(..., 0o600) and fchmod over an existing file

findings.title: CLI default report name built from org_name could hold ../ or a drive path
Configuration file read without a size or nesting cap; non-UTF-8 or deep nesting raised a traceback
findings.fix: 64 KB cap; UnicodeDecodeError and RecursionError become ConfigError

findings.title: Analysis ScopedClient did not map /zid and /ziam reads to the ZIdentity scope
findings.fix: _SERVICE_SCOPE maps zid and ziam to zidentity

findings.title: A token answer with expires_in as text made sign-in fail
findings.fix: _expires_in reads a number or numeric text, else 3600

findings.title: compute() raised on a non-dict row or a row without status (saved files from earlier versions)
findings.fix: Non-results are skipped; an unknown status is informational, never a pass

findings.title: 3.7 called a 403 'not licensed'; MC.3 scored a not-licensed 404 as REVIEW
Web DLP action given as an object crashed 5.3 (unhashable dict as a counter key)
4.6 listed duplicate SSL rule names in set order (non-deterministic finding text)

zcc_evaluation (spliced into sections 1, 6, 12): 1.16-1.23 PASS on zero active app profiles ('all 0 profile(s)'), and 1.27/1.28 call a 403 'not readable' without the status, so it is not classed as not permitted. 1.24-1.26 also pass on zero forwarding profiles (same pattern, not in this patch).
findings.fix: Return INFO when no active profile is returned; name the HTTP status of an unreadable company/privacy read
findings.test: tests/test_c6_assessment.py (probe: run zcc_evaluation checks with AllCode(403) and AllCode(200, [])); patch verified against tests/test_zcc_evaluation.py, test_zcc_paths.py, test_zcc_device_state.py (45 passed)
findings.proposed_patch:
--- a/zcc_evaluation.py
+++ b/zcc_evaluation.py
@@ -166,7 +166,11 @@
     d, e = _g(cl, "/zcc/appProfiles", "AppProfiles")
     if e:
         return None, e
-    return [flatten_profile(p) for p in d if isinstance(p, dict) and _active(flatten_profile(p))], None
+    out = [flatten_profile(p) for p in d if isinstance(p, dict) and _active(flatten_profile(p))]
+    if not out:
+        # Nothing to assess is not a pass: "all 0 profile(s)" must not count as configured.
+        return None, R(R.INFO, "No active Client Connector app profile was returned, so this setting cannot be assessed.")
+    return out, None
 
 
 def _list(cl, ep: str) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], Optional[int]]:
@@ -580,7 +584,8 @@

     # Rollout, cleanup and FIPS live in the nested webAppConfig (SDK CompanyInfo.WebAppConfig).

-        return R(R.INFO, "Web privacy settings: not readable (getWebPrivacyInfo).")

+        return R(R.INFO, "Web privacy settings: not readable (getWebPrivacyInfo)" + (f" (HTTP {code})" if code not in (200, 204) else "") + ".")
     warns = []
     if _falsy_set(_v(p, "collectUserInfo")):
